_meta.note: Open-weights LLM leaderboard from artificialanalysis.ai. Models are fetched from https://artificialanalysis.ai/leaderboards/models?weights=open and tracked exclusively with AA metrics. Run python3 tracker/fetch_aa.py to refresh.

categories.label: Intelligence
categories.axis: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index: a composite score measuring model reasoning ability across multiple benchmarks. Higher is better.

categories.label: Cost per Task
categories.axis: Cost in USD to complete one Intelligence Index task. Lower is better.

categories.label: Speed (Time per Task)
categories.axis: Median time in minutes to complete one Intelligence Index task. Lower is better.

categories.label: Latency (First Token)
categories.axis: Time to first answer token in seconds. Lower is better.

categories.label: Context Window
categories.axis: Maximum context window in tokens. Higher is better.
